text:
alex: Heads up — saw a latency spike on sm92 farm after yesterday's kernel-autotune merge. :thinking:
alex: 50–200ms extra p50 for seqlen 128 workloads, mostly in the attention forward path.
priya: Hmm. Did the probe change the kernel selection thresholds for pipelined kernels?
alex: I reverted the capflag-to-path map locally. The spike disappears. Attaching a small perf dump from benchbot.
benchbot: perf-summary: run=2026-03-17T09:12Z nodes=8 model=gpt-small seq=128 batch=4
benchbot: p50=180ms p90=310ms p99=480ms (post-merge)
benchbot: p50=120ms p90=200ms p99=360ms (reverted)
ross: Could be a warmup/probe ordering issue — new sensor picks pipelined-kernel for sm92 earlier than kv-cache warms up.
priya: That would increase KV cache misses and cause more memcpy/alloc churn.
alex: Here's the small snippet of the decision logic that changed:
alex: ```
// old: prefer non-pipelined for seq <= 128 on sm>=92
if (sm >= 92 && seq_len <= 128) choose(path::pipelined);
// new: prefer pipelined when tensor_cores && bf16_supported
```
ross: If pipelined path assumes prepopulated kvcache sizes, the mismatch will force evictions. Did we change the kvcache prefetch size?
alex: Not intentionally, but the kernel path switch changed the runtime's expected kvslot-per-batch. See logs:
alex: ```
runtime: selected path=pipelined_kv_v2 (sm=92 tc=1 bf16=1)
kvcache: prefetch_slots=8 => used_slots=2 => evict_rate=high
```
priya: My suggestion: add a gating check — only pick pipelined if kv_cache_warmth_score >= 0.6, or fall back to non-pipelined for first N requests per session.
ross: Also add a microbench: iteratively flip selection and run small seq128 x batch1 to see cold start cost.
alex: Agreed. I'll push a quick patch to add a warmup window flag and re-run. Can someone review if I also add a short histogram to console?
benchbot: perf-diff: with warmup_gate enabled -> p50 down to 125ms, p90 210ms
devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed to sm92 pool (canary=3 nodes) by alex at 09:47Z
priya: Nice. Also add a log metric for chosen_kernel + kv_miss_rate so we can correlate.
ross: And include an integration test that simulates kvcache cold path under seq128.
alex: Will do. Opening PR w/ tests and a flag: runtime:feature.warmup_kernel_gate
alex: thx all :thumbsup:
